title: How To Search For Sub Account Members In The Database
text:
## How To Search For Sub Account Members In The Database
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000060081
To see the list of members who have been added as a sub account, Navigate to Developers --> MySQL Database :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181295265/original/JTbR7UUvK-JVmiCXwHSzwsduycvxoxcIgw.png?1782859186 | alt: ]
Click on the database that ends with wording " directory ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12054756843/original/-TTymp_26JNpYlimLXee1IrWG4XeblcAHg.png?1564938216 | alt: ]
Conduct a search for the table users_data and open it by clicking on it:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12054756885/original/wAcgeIaMYrBS2xKDcwFmB8yjTBnTlpMWAw.png?1564938245 | alt: ]
Click on SQL :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12054756890/original/I5MGdBi_epDaBJGuBdTxjKQulEDix-Fmqg.png?1564938274 | alt: ]
Paste the specified SQL code and click Go :
